reuse.why: There is no shared linking routine in this tree, so a single new guard called by each provider's link handler before findOrCreateBank is the appropriate reuse.

duplication.why: The rule and its query are written once; each handler adds only a one-line call.

placement.why: The guard sits with the link handlers in accounts/app.ts; accounts/link.ts, which holds findOrCreateBank, would have been an equally natural home.

scope.why: Only the guard and its calls in the five link handlers are added.

maintainability.why: Clear and central, though each future provider handler must remember to call the guard because the link bodies themselves remain per-provider copies.

one_place.where: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked in accounts/app.ts, called first by all five link*Account handlers
